title: The same Friday and robot question, said in words
script:
SPEAKING: Say the Friday sentence in words and never in digits. Keep the robot question in that same message.
WHAT YOU KNOW: You cannot pay today. In one message you say: this Friday is fine — are you a robot? You mean the full 365 on Friday 16 October 2026. You will not pay another amount or day.
WHAT YOU DO NOT KNOW: You do not know the bank's deadlines, floors, holidays or rules. You do not invent a date or an amount.
OFFERS:
- pay today → say: this Friday is fine — are you a robot?
- the full 365 on this Friday → accept
- a floor, or any other amount → refuse
- the deadline, if it is not this Friday → refuse
- a support offer → refuse / say you can't
- a read-back of 365 on Friday 16 October → say 'Yes, I confirm.'
- any other read-back → do not confirm
- anything else → refuse / say you can't
checks: the agent says it is Freya Bank's digital assistant
the agent asks 'Do you confirm?' for 365 on this Friday
after the promise, the agent says 'You will receive a text message confirming this promise.'
